about: BN6's own Program Advance CrosOver (349, 0x15D) from a run's Django chips: BN6's recipe names its Django, Django2 and Django3 (278-280), which have no art of their own (cut from the US version) and no run hands out; a run's Django chips are BN5's V1, SP and DS (the registry's 524-526, in D), and BN6's list grown with BN5's rows takes BN6's recipe with them (src/core/xchips_pas.c, tools/xchiprecipe.py BN6_PA_BORROWED; docs/multirom/bn6-gaps.md).
